procedure_name: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
summary: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading sector.
estimated_total_cost: ₹0 application fee; lowest commercial interest rate

steps.title: Greenfield business project report
steps.description: Prepare detailed project report (DPR) showing proposed business, machinery cost, and financial viability.

steps.title: Verify SC/ST or Woman category
steps.description: Borrower must be a woman or SC/ST entrepreneur holding at least 51% shareholding in enterprise.

steps.title: Apply on Stand-Up Mitra portal
steps.description: Submit loan application selecting preferred scheduled commercial bank branch.
documents_needed: Audited balance sheets (if existing) / Net worth statements

steps.title: Bank appraisal and credit evaluation
steps.description: Bank manager reviews collateral/Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGFSI) and evaluates business model.

steps.title: Loan sanction and disbursement
steps.description: Receive composite loan sanction (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore.
